SELECT p.pno, p.name, p.addr, p.category, p.type, p.thumbnail, p.hit, p.created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT f.fno) AS f_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_id) AS l_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rno) AS r_count FROM place p LEFT JOIN favorite f ON p.pno = f.pno LEFT JOIN userlike l ON p.pno = l.pno LEFT JOIN review r ON p.pno = r.pno WHERE type IN('연극/뮤지컬', '전시', '액티비티')
AND ${column} LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
GROUP BY p.pno, p.name, p.addr, p.category, p.type, p.thumbnail, p.hit, p.created_at ORDER BY ${selected} DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 16 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/16.0) FROM place WHERE type IN('연극/뮤지컬', '전시', '액티비티')
AND ${column} LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'

SELECT p.pno, p.thumbnail, p.type, p.name, p.imgs, p.company, p.runtime, p.phone, p.parking, p.addr, p.rating, p.hours, p.hit, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createday, NVL(f.f_count, 0) AS f_count, NVL(l.l_count, 0) AS l_count FROM place p LEFT JOIN (SELECT pno, COUNT(*) AS f_count FROM favorite GROUP BY pno) f ON p.pno = f.pno LEFT JOIN (SELECT pno, COUNT(*) AS l_count FROM userlike GROUP BY pno) l ON p.pno = l.pno WHERE p.type IN('연극/뮤지컬', '전시', '액티비티') AND p.pno = #{pno}
